role: XCUITest of the first-run path: the health disclaimer gates a fresh install, accepting it reveals onboarding, and an all-skip walk of onboarding reaches the app.

flags.text: Passes the bare '-UITests' launch argument, which no production code reads (only -UITests-FreshInstall at AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185 and -UITests-ForcePaywall/-UITests-SeedArchive at UITestLaunchArguments.swift:18,23 are checked); it is inert

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false and launches with -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English; does not walk gates.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Asserts the 'Health Disclaimer' heading or disclaimer.agree appears; if a tab bar exists asserts its first button is not safely hittable (covered).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: assert first tab button not hittable; else no tab assertion

flags.text: Asserts the first tab button is not safely hittable under the disclaimer cover, but the harness states that on iOS 26 the tab bar under a fullScreenCover reports hittable (EmuquUITests.swift:681-684); the two cannot both hold, so either this assertion fails on iOS 26 or the harness comment is wrong

units.does: Asserts disclaimer.agree appears, swipes the first scroll view up to 6 times until enabled, asserts it is enabled, taps it, then asserts 'Welcome to Emuqu' text, 'Get started' or 'Next' button appears.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.cond: for up to 6 swipes while agree disabled

flags.text: Queries static text 'Welcome to Emuqu', which no longer exists in the app (OnboardingWelcomePage shows 'Emuqu' and a tagline); the test passes only through the English 'Get started' button label, contrary to the identifier contract at EmuquUITests.swift:51-58

units.does: Accepts the disclaimer if possible, then for up to 12 iterations taps onboarding.skip (recording that a skip was seen) or onboarding.advance when safely hittable, ending when neither exists and a tab bar exists; asserts a skip was seen and the app was reached.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: try to enable and accept it

branches.cond: for up to 6 swipes while disabled
neither control exists and a tab bar exists
branches.effect: reachedApp=true, break; else wait 2s for any text

flags.text: 'reachedApp' is decided by tabBar.exists with no gate present, which the harness documents is true under a cover (EmuquUITests.swift:593-596); a transition gap between onboarding pages, or the paywall cover (never checked here), satisfies it, so the 'lands the user in the app' assertion can pass while a modal is still up
Named for the onboarding Health page but never identifies or asserts anything about that page; any onboarding.skip on any page satisfies sawSkipAffordance

Resolves onboarding.skip/advance with matching(identifier:).firstMatch, which the harness documents can resolve to a zero-frame neighbouring page of the paged OnboardingView TabView (EmuquUITests.swift:694-699, fixed there with allElementsBoundByIndex at 723); such an element exists but isSafelyHittable returns false, so the loop neither taps nor sets reachedApp and can burn its 12 iterations
